configurations.name: playground
runtimeArgs: import os, functools, http.server; port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', '5174')); handler = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=os.getcwd()); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; print('serving', os.getcwd(), 'on', port, flush=True); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('', port), handler).serve_forever()
